description: This file provides functions to fetch user analytics data from a backend API, including tenant user summaries and active user trends. It includes helper functions for normalizing query parameters and handles API responses with error management.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to convert query parameters by transforming Date instances or ISO strings, and removing undefined/null/empty string values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches tenant-wise user summary data from the API with optional filters like date range, status, and inclusion of inactive tenants. Handles API errors gracefully.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches time-bucketed active user data, supporting filters like date range, granularity, status, and tenant scope. Handles errors and returns empty data for certain client errors.
